argv: decision 0178 lets OSM locate a pinned table of small types
ops.body: - **Places only OpenStreetMap knows** (the Bethlehem Steel blast furnaces' own feature): the owner's call, corroborate only (0110); adding them makes the archive a derived ODbL database. Answered in part by decision 0178 (Nov 14): OSM may locate a pinned table of small types (plaques, time capsules, little libraries and the like); every other type, the furnaces' feature among them, still only corroborates.
